title: Tenant export and deletion
description:
What: one command exports or deletes every row and object of a tenant. The tenant owns all of it; export is complete and in open formats.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Export holds everything
  Given a tenant with content, media and settings
  When it exports
  Then the archive reopens as a complete dedicated seed
Scenario: Deletion leaves nothing behind

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented by PPY-e882ee and PPY-62f10d; listing every row of a tenant without a whole-table read needs PPY-1ce06f on the tables with no tenant path.
